blinding_guess.why: Taken alone, prog is internally consistent for all ten listed elements: every code is defined once (lines 4-17), each consumed message is decoded with an explicit integer count and a scale constant, and each provided message has a fixed send sequence. Whether any of them is defective depends on whether the peer encodes the same codes, counts and multipliers (e.g. MULT_analog 1000000.0, MULT_time 1000000.0, 2 ints for MSG_SET_TOOL_VOLTAGE including a dummy), and I did not inspect the peer.
